elements.name: Auto-Turret
elements.brief: Single-barrel auto-turret: square base plate with power cables, yaw joint, sensor-cluster head with a 3-stud barrel and faint red muzzle ring. Sub-meshes: Base, Head.

elements.name: Stalker (jungle)
elements.brief: Quadruped predator: chitinous plates with magenta bioluminescent seams, 2x3 teal eye cluster, mandible mouth, spine frill, segmented glowing tail tip. Low predatory stance.

elements.name: Combat drone
elements.brief: Wedge fighter drone, twin forward laser barrels, red sensor lens, red-orange thrusters, charcoal/red.

elements.name: Bioluminescent Jungle Arch
elements.brief: Corroded military structural frame overgrown by alien jungle: glowing vines on weathered titanium beams, magenta/teal bioluminescent flora in the cracks.

elements.name: Extractor
elements.brief: Compact resource extractor: drill column into a crystal node, spinning collar, side coolant tanks, teal intake glow at the base, credit-coil readout on top. Reads as the colony's income core.

elements.name: Wall segment
elements.brief: Modular 4-stud wall segment: layered armor plates over a titanium spine, energy-seam glow along the top edge, tileable ends so segments chain cleanly. Three damage states later (see dmg_*).

elements.name: Resource node (crystal cluster)
elements.brief: Ground crystal cluster the extractor drills into: teal-core crystals in a rock collar with a faint pulse. Must read as 'place extractor here' from FTUE distance.

elements.name: Hitscan rifle — world model
elements.brief: Compact sci-fi carbine: charcoal body, steel-blue rails, teal energy cell window, short muzzle with a red emissive ring. Held R15 grip.

elements.name: Hitscan rifle — first-person view model
elements.brief: Same rifle with a higher-detail front half for first-person; consistent with the world model.

elements.name: Muzzle flash texture
elements.integration_target: BeamPool muzzle emitter texture via AssetIds (H4)
elements.brief: Star-burst flash sprite, teal-white core, red rim; 256x256 alpha.

elements.name: Outpost-7 emblem
elements.brief: The game's own emblem: a stylized '7' inside a hex outpost silhouette, teal/gold. Original mark — also used for listing branding.

elements.name: Jungle — vine tree
elements.brief: Twisted alien tree: dark trunk wrapped in glowing magenta vines, teal spore pods at the tips, roots gripping a rock. Silhouette-first; reads at distance.

elements.name: Jungle — glow fern cluster
elements.brief: Low fern cluster with bioluminescent leaf veins; the ground-cover filler placed 24x per plot.

elements.name: Jungle — spore pod
elements.brief: Bulbous stalk with a translucent pod full of drifting magenta motes; particle emitter host.

elements.name: Plot floor tile
elements.brief: Tileable 4-stud landing-pad plate texture: hex panels, faint grid lines, worn edges; 4x4 grid must align to Constants.GRID.Size.

elements.name: Plot border beacon
elements.brief: Corner post with a vertical light strip marking plot bounds; colored by biome accent.

elements.name: Spawn dropship pad
elements.brief: Circular landing pad with chevrons and blue edge lights; the player's spawn point and the raid 'extraction' anchor.

elements.name: Jungle spore particle
elements.brief: Soft magenta mote with teal core, 128x128 alpha.

elements.name: Turret beam texture
elements.brief: Horizontal beam strip with bright core and soft falloff, 512x64.

elements.name: Drone beam texture
elements.brief: Thinner, faster-looking strip with a dashed energy pattern, 512x64.

elements.name: Impact spark particle
elements.brief: Sharp spark shard, white-hot core, 64x64 alpha.

elements.name: Heavy Cannon Turret
elements.brief: Twin-barrel siege turret: reinforced base with bracing struts, thick frontal armor, dual 4-stud barrels with heat-vent gills, red optic between barrels, visible ammo belt. Sub-meshes: Base, Head.

elements.name: Burst Laser Turret
elements.brief: Sleek point-defense laser: flowing base, yaw+pitch joints, 2x3 emitter grid with blue plasma lenses, spinning radar element on top, blue emissive radiator seams. Sub-meshes: Base, Yaw, Head.

elements.name: Magmaling (volcanic)
elements.brief: Hunched bipedal heavy: cracked obsidian armor over a molten core, arms to the ground ending in three-finger claws, featureless dome head with a glowing horizontal crack, back heat vents.

elements.name: Cryowraith (ice)
elements.brief: Tall thin floating wraith of fractured translucent ice, blue emissive veins, three vertical eye slits, icicle-claw arms, lower body dissolving into frost mist.

elements.name: Recon drone
elements.brief: Bird-like scout drone, single cyclopean sensor pod, pale blue silent thrusters, white/recon-blue.

elements.name: Engineering drone
elements.brief: Utility repair drone, olive/green, retracted manipulator arm under a tool bay, three status LEDs. Sub-meshes: Body, Arm.

elements.name: Loot core (raid extractor variant)
elements.brief: The extractor with an exposed glowing credit core and a 'crack me' vulnerability window; reads as the raid target.

elements.name: Raid arena floor
elements.brief: Darker industrial variant of the plot floor tile for the reserved-server raid place.

elements.name: Attacker spawn pad
elements.brief: Red-lit variant of the dropship pad marking the attacker's entry / extraction point.

elements.name: Volcanic Arch
elements.brief: Obsidian-and-steel archway, hex-paneled crossbeam, molten lava fissures glowing inside cracked obsidian pillars, faded amber chevrons.

elements.name: Ice Cave Arch
elements.brief: Titanium frame encased in translucent fractured ice with blue-white emissive veins, pale rune line along the inner edge, frost mist at the base.

elements.name: Volcanic — obsidian fissure stub
elements.brief: Jagged obsidian shard cluster split by a glowing lava crack; ember emitter host.

elements.name: Volcanic — ash-dead tree
elements.brief: Blackened leafless tree with glowing ember veins in the bark.

elements.name: Ice — crystal cluster
elements.brief: Translucent blue crystal spikes with internal emissive veins; frost mist emitter host.

elements.name: Ice — frozen shrub
elements.brief: Ice-glazed alien shrub, pale white edges, faint blue subsurface glow.

elements.name: Volcanic ash particle
elements.brief: Grey-orange ash flake with ember edge, 128x128 alpha.

elements.name: Frost flake particle
elements.brief: Six-point frost flake, pale blue, 128x128 alpha.

elements.name: Wall — cracked decal
elements.brief: Alpha decal of fracture lines + scorch for the wall at 66-33% HP; readable at 20 studs on mobile.

elements.name: Wall — breached/burning
elements.brief: Alpha decal of a breach gap with molten edges + ember emissive map; pairs with a particle burst.

elements.name: Turret — sparking damage
elements.brief: Exposed-wiring decal + spark emissive for a damaged turret head.

elements.name: Extractor — disabled
elements.brief: Dead-glow variant: intake light off, warning-amber fault strip, oil-leak decal at the base.

elements.name: Ring beacon
elements.brief: Rotating ground ring with chevrons pointing inward; accent-colored emissive; replaces the procedural segments.

elements.name: HUD pointer arrow
elements.brief: Angular sci-fi arrow glyph used for on-screen pointers.

elements.name: Intro cinematic title card
elements.brief: Wide 16:9 title frame: outpost silhouette against the bioluminescent jungle at dusk, emblem top-left, no text.

elements.name: Jungle skybox (6 faces)
elements.brief: Post-dusk deep-purple sky with a magenta nebula band and two moons; seamless cube map.

elements.name: Volcanic skybox (6 faces)
elements.brief: Ash-orange sunset haze, distant eruption glow on one horizon.

elements.name: Ice skybox (6 faces)
elements.brief: Pre-dawn cold blue with aurora ribbons.

elements.name: Stalactite
elements.brief: Hanging ice spike, faceted, subtle internal glow; tileable at three scales.

elements.name: Stalagmite
elements.brief: Floor ice spike ring element; wider base, frost at the foot.

elements.name: Glacier wall slab
elements.brief: Horizon-scale glacier slab with a titanium frame half-buried in it; the amphitheatre silhouette.

elements.name: Red Chevron decal
elements.brief: Forward-facing chevron insignia, warning red on transparent; plus a 256x256 panel icon.

elements.name: Amber Skull decal
elements.brief: Stylized non-gory skull insignia, amber glow; panel icon.

elements.name: Neon Red trail
elements.brief: Beam texture strip + panel icon, blood-red.

elements.name: Neon Blue trail
elements.brief: Beam texture strip + panel icon, electric blue.

elements.name: Neon Gold trail
elements.brief: Beam texture strip + panel icon, legendary gold with a subtle shimmer.

elements.name: Pioneer flair
elements.brief: Small gold badge glyph for early adopters.

elements.name: Veteran flair
elements.brief: Small teal/blue badge glyph for BP tier 25.

elements.name: Combatant Operator (default)
elements.brief: Medium frontline armor, charcoal black, red accent stripes, full-face helmet with a red visor band. The stock silhouette.

elements.name: Recon Operator
elements.brief: Sleek scout armor, matte dark-grey, neon teal stripes, wraparound visor, asymmetric single pauldron.

elements.name: Heavy Defender Operator
elements.brief: Bulky exoskeleton armor, gunmetal, amber glow seams, oversized pauldrons, vertical visor slit.

elements.name: Game pass icon — 2× Credits
elements.brief: 512x512 square, credits glyph doubled with a gold burst.

elements.name: Game pass icon — Auto-Collect
elements.brief: Extractor with a magnet/collect arrow motif.

elements.name: Game pass icon — VIP Operator
elements.brief: Heavy Defender helmet silhouette with amber glow.

elements.name: Game pass icon — Battle Pass Premium
elements.brief: Emblem on a premium banner ribbon.

elements.name: Dev product icon — Emergency Shield
elements.brief: Hex shield over a plot silhouette, blue.

elements.name: Dev product icon — Credit Pack (Small)
elements.brief: Small stack of credit coils.

elements.name: Dev product icon — Credit Pack (Large)
elements.brief: Large crate of credit coils.

elements.name: Dev product icon — Core Pack
elements.brief: Cluster of glowing cores.

elements.name: Battle Pass premium banner
elements.brief: Wide banner: Recon operator + drone over the jungle at dusk, season-one framing, no text.

elements.name: Game icon
elements.brief: 512x512: emblem + outpost silhouette; made from a real staging screenshot after the world art lands. LAST.

elements.name: Thumbnail — Day 1 vs Day 30
elements.brief: Split-frame transformation from real screenshots. LAST.

elements.name: Thumbnail — wave breach
elements.brief: The 'oh no, the east wall' moment from a real screenshot. LAST.

elements.name: Thumbnail — raid drama
elements.brief: Attacker at the loot core, klaxon glow. LAST.

elements.name: All-terrain rover
elements.brief: 6-wheel armored exploration buggy, roll cage, cargo bed, plasma exhaust. Sub-meshes: Chassis, Wheel x6.

elements.name: Hover bike
elements.brief: Single-rider hover bike, integrated twin plasma cannons, downforce wings, blue ground-effect glow. Original silhouette.

elements.name: Hover tank
elements.brief: Dual-crew hover tank, sloped glacis, ring-mount laser turret, plasma vents. Sub-meshes: Chassis, TurretRing, TurretHead.
